spec.title: Architecture Review: Headless Primitives as the Foundation of Multi-Brand Systems - Comparison Analysis

steps.label: Architecture Foundation
steps.leftCaption: Tightly coupled components bundle styles and business state together.
steps.rightCaption: Decoupled headless primitives isolate state from visual presentation.

steps.label: Accessibility Standards
steps.leftCaption: Manual markup often breaks assistive screen reader navigation contracts.
steps.rightCaption: Automated helper attributes guarantee complete accessibility compliance.

steps.label: Real World Systems
steps.leftCaption: Single chassis vehicles cannot adapt to diverse transport requirements.
steps.rightCaption: Universal vehicle chassis power diverse customized transport airframes.

steps.label: Interactive Verification
steps.leftCaption: Hardcoded styles require tedious regression testing across codebases.
steps.rightCaption: Unified headless engines deliver consistent behavior across all brands.
